title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your code wrote itself?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is breaking onto Hacker News with 440 points and 200 comments — and it’s changing how we code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s an open source AI that writes, debugs, and documents code in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its unique feature? It learns from your coding style and adapts on the fly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, startups, and coders everywhere can now automate repetitive tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just a tool — it’s a new way of thinking about collaboration.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see the future of coding? Follow me and I’ll show you how.
